text:
maria: Oncall handoff in ~30m. Quick capacity note: west-gpu-pool at ~82% avg (5m). Burst budget ~38% remaining. Planning to hand to @kevin unless someone needs to swap.

kevin: I can take it unless priya wants it. Any scheduled batch jobs tonight?

ops-bot: Scheduled job detected: big-embed-batch for customer 'Skyline' starting 23:00 UTC — est 45m runtime.

maria: Yes — Skyline run at 23:00 UTC (~1.2M tokens). Expect a short spike. Plan: allow pool burst to 150% if tail latency stays <=200ms, otherwise fallback to small-model variant.

priya: If you handoff to me I can cover until 02:00 UTC. Can someone add me to the rota for this window?

kevin: I'm good covering. Priya — if you want to pick up the overnight chunk ping me and I'll swap. I'll monitor tail latency and headroom.

jen: FYI noticed a steady rise in KV cache misses on the prod-replay route (up to ~6% last 10m) — could nudge cost during the embed job. Dashboard: https://monitoring/redwood/pool/west

maria: Thanks jen. If misses stay >5% during the Skyline job, throttle the replay route to avoid cost blowout. Command to pause route: ```rlctl route pause prod-replay --reason 'burst protection'```

ops-bot: Alert: pool-west burst remaining now 36% (alert threshold 30%). No immediate action required.

kevin: I'll run a quick pre-check 15m before handoff. Quick ask: can someone confirm dedicated-reserve has 2 free slots for fallback?

priya: Confirmed — dedicated-reserve has 2 free slots. If pool utilization >95% I'll open a swap to dedicated and notify customers on the retain plan.

maria: :thumbsup: Handoff note in case I'm unreachable: evict low-priority jobs with `evict-jobs --pool west --label batch-low`. Leave a short status in the oncall doc after takeover.

kevin: Got it. I'll leave a takeover note and monitor the replay route closely.
